about_short_description.short_description: Yhangry is a private chef marketplace, where you can book a chef whenever you want to socialise at home.

product.name: Private Chef Booking Service
product.description: A platform to book private chefs for events at home or rented venues across the UK and the US, providing personalized menus and quotes from multiple chefs.

product.name: Chef Quote and Menu Customization
product.description: A feature enabling customers to receive multiple personalized menu proposals and quotes from chefs and communicate directly to customize their event menus.

product.name: Secure Payment and Booking Protection
product.description: A payment system that holds funds in escrow until after the event, ensuring secure transactions and protection against no-shows or cancellations.

product.name: Public Liability Insurance Coverage
product.description: Insurance coverage that protects customers against accidents caused by chefs during events booked through the platform.

product.name: Flexible Cancellation and Refund Policy
product.description: A cancellation policy allowing full refunds up to seven days before the event and assistance with rebooking if a chef cancels.

identifier.value: Split Bill and Deposit Payment Options

product.name: Split Bill and Deposit Payment Options
product.description: Payment options allowing customers to pay a 10% deposit or split the bill among guests for bookings made more than five weeks in advance.
